title: Modding school
description:
The original shape for this one is the School puzzle created by Quxwozing. I made 3 modifications: extended the 2 triloop stacks, and shortened the tetraloop stack. Unfortunately my solution for the lower half was incompatible with 3 nt long triloop stacks (even one of those, much less two) :P

I would love to see a different solution to the lower left stack, if such a thing exists. I will likely re-create it later in a smaller puzzle. In the meantime, if you solve this, please send it my way. Thank you!
